$comment: Footnote demo fixture — real cards replayed from the public field record across the project's eras: the first manual field test (docs/FIELD_TEST_2026-08-08.md), the PASS-2 TESTAIR session (same doc, addendum), the street session (docs/FIELD_TEST_2026-08-10_STREET.md), and the D18 supervised auto-air pilot (docs/D18_PILOT_FIELD_REPORT_2026-08-12.md). Verdicts, confidences and framings match those records; corrections/sources follow the adjudicated notes in eval/golden. No invented cards, no operator-private data (raw session JSONLs are gitignored; everything here is quoted in the docs). demo.mode drives how tools/demo/run.js replays each card: 'operator' = veto window then a human-path air (op:cmd); 'auto' = D18 choreography (4s veto countdown, then the machine airs it — AUTO-marked on receipts); 'testair' = PASS-2 choreography (settled verdict airs immediately, TEST watermark); 'hold' = D4 person-claim posture (MANUAL tag, never machine-aired; demo holds it for a human); 'skip' = the R41 street norm (don't air what we couldn't verify). Dispositions are demo choreography — e.g. the Thiel card was operator-aired in its original 2026-08-08 session; here it demonstrates the person-hold posture that D4 enforces on the auto path. The four-minute-mile card is FS-1 shown CORRECTLY: the displayed claim keeps the speaker's negation and the verdict is of the claim as spoken. The measles card is one of the first machine-aired polarity-applied verdicts (D17): the canonical claim is False, the speaker DENIED it, the overlay rendered the speaker's framing.

cards.claim: Gold is worth more than silver.
cards.canonical: Gold is worth more than silver.
cards.correction: Correct — gold has traded above silver per ounce for centuries.
